name: infra-cdk
description: AWS CDK infra provider. Compose-host env vars are read at deploy time and baked into EC2 user-data.

imports.name: THONNAS_PROJECT_NAME
imports.description: Project name from root thonnas-package.json; used in CloudFormation stack prefix for per-project scope.

imports.name: THONNAS_INSTALL_URL
imports.description: Install URL for Thonnas CLI (curl | sh); injected into EC2 user-data so compose host can install CLI. Future URLs may include version for reproducible builds.

exports.name: INFRA_CDK_LOCALSTACK_PORT
exports.description: Deprecated host-port alias. LocalStack is owned by @thonnas/infra-localstack (INFRA_LOCALSTACK_PORT). Kept so existing project/config.json keys keep working.

exports.name: THONNAS_AWS_CLI
exports.description: AWS CLI command name. Use 'awslocal' in development (with LocalStack) so commands target LocalStack; use 'aws' in non-development for real AWS.

exports.name: INFRA_CDK_S3_ENDPOINT
exports.description: S3 endpoint URL for containers. In development set to the single @thonnas/infra-localstack service (http://infra-localstack:4566). In other environments set to live AWS, e.g. https://s3.${AWS_REGION}.amazonaws.com (not from AWS CLI; derive from AWS_REGION). Omit or leave unset for SDK default.

exports.name: AWS_REGION
exports.description: AWS region for LocalStack and S3 (bucket region).

exports.name: INFRA_CDK_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN
exports.description: IAM role ARN assumed by CI via GitHub OIDC. Non-secret. Required before config.resolve on GitHub-hosted runners. Leave empty in development (local SSO/instance role no-ops identity.assume). After the first laptop apply of the GithubOidc stack, copy the DeployRoleArn output here for beta+.

exports.name: INFRA_CDK_OIDC_AUDIENCE
exports.description: Audience for the GitHub OIDC JWT (sts.amazonaws.com). Non-secret. Used by identity.assume and the IAM trust policy.

exports.name: INFRA_CDK_GITHUB_ORG
exports.description: GitHub org or user that may assume the deploy role. Non-secret. Prompted by thonnas config setup; stored in the consuming project's project/config.json. Required to synthesize the OIDC trust stack (skipped when empty).

exports.name: INFRA_CDK_GITHUB_REPO
exports.description: GitHub repository name (not owner) trusted by the deploy role. Non-secret. Prompted by thonnas config setup; stored in the consuming project's project/config.json.

exports.name: INFRA_CDK_OIDC_SUBJECT
exports.description: Optional comma-separated GitHub sub claim patterns (StringLike). When empty, defaults to repo:ORG/REPO:environment:ENV and repo:ORG/REPO:ref:refs/heads/ENV.

exports.name: INFRA_CDK_OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN
exports.description: Optional existing IAM OIDC provider ARN for token.actions.githubusercontent.com. Apply auto-imports the account GitHub IdP when this is empty. The IdP is account-wide and is retained on stack destroy.

internal.name: THONNAS_COMPOSE_GIT_REPO_URL
internal.description: Git repository URL for compose-host EC2. Prompted by thonnas config setup; injected into user-data at deploy time.

internal.name: THONNAS_COMPOSE_GIT_USERNAME
internal.description: Git clone username for private repos. Prompted by thonnas config setup; injected into user-data at deploy time.

internal.name: THONNAS_COMPOSE_GIT_BRANCH
internal.description: Git branch for compose-host (defaults to feature branch or main). Injected into user-data at deploy time.

internal.name: THONNAS_COMPOSE_GIT_PASSWORD_SECRET_NAME
internal.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret name for git clone password. Injected into user-data at deploy time.

internal.name: THONNAS_ROOT_DOMAIN
internal.description: Root domain for hostnames. Prompted by thonnas config setup; used for compose-host and other infra hostnames.
